## Imports

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr) 
library(tidymodels)
application_test<-read_csv(here::here("data/application_test.csv")) 
application_train <- read_csv(here::here("data/application_train.csv")) 
bureau_bal <- read_csv(here::here("data/bureau_balance.csv"))
bureau <- read_csv(here::here("data/bureau.csv")) 
ccbal <- read_csv(here::here("data/credit_card_balance.csv")) 
homecredit <- read_csv(here::here("data/HomeCredit_columns_description.csv")) 
cashbal <- read_csv(here::here("data/POS_CASH_balance.csv")) 
prevapp <- read_csv(here::here("data/previous_application.csv")) 
sample_sub <- read_csv(here::here("data/sample_submission.csv"))
```

## Reading in the Data

### Random Split of Data

```{r}
set.seed(123)
train_size <- floor(0.80 * nrow(application_train))
train_indices <- sample(seq_len(nrow(application_train)), size = train_size)
ran_train_data <- application_train[train_indices, ]
ran_val_data <- application_train[-train_indices, ]
```

### Stratified Split

```{r}
library(tidymodels)
split_strat <- initial_split(application_train, prop = 0.8, strata = "TARGET")
strat_train_data <- training(split_strat)
strat_val_data <- testing(split_strat)
```

### Non Random Split - Represent Test Data

```{r}
glimpse(application_test)
```

## Data Engineering

```{r}
library(corrplot)
library(Hmisc)



clean_application_train <- application_train|>
  mutate(REGION_RATING = ((REGION_RATING_CLIENT+REGION_RATING_CLIENT_W_CITY)/2))|>
  select(c(SK_ID_CURR, TARGET, NAME_CONTRACT_TYPE, CODE_GENDER, FLAG_OWN_CAR, FLAG_OWN_REALTY, CNT_CHILDREN, AMT_INCOME_TOTAL, AMT_CREDIT, AMT_ANNUITY, AMT_GOODS_PRICE, NAME_INCOME_TYPE, NAME_EDUCATION_TYPE, NAME_FAMILY_STATUS, NAME_HOUSING_TYPE, REGION_POPULATION_RELATIVE, DAYS_BIRTH, DAYS_EMPLOYED, DAYS_REGISTRATION, DAYS_ID_PUBLISH,, FLAG_MOBIL, FLAG_EMP_PHONE, FLAG_WORK_PHONE, FLAG_CONT_MOBILE, FLAG_PHONE, FLAG_EMAIL, CNT_FAM_MEMBERS, REGION_RATING_CLIENT, REGION_RATING_CLIENT_W_CITY, REG_REGION_NOT_LIVE_REGION, REG_REGION_NOT_WORK_REGION, LIVE_REGION_NOT_WORK_REGION, REG_CITY_NOT_LIVE_CITY, REG_CITY_NOT_WORK_CITY, LIVE_CITY_NOT_WORK_CITY, EXT_SOURCE_1, EXT_SOURCE_2, EXT_SOURCE_3 ,OBS_30_CNT_SOCIAL_CIRCLE, DEF_30_CNT_SOCIAL_CIRCLE, OBS_60_CNT_SOCIAL_CIRCLE, DEF_60_CNT_SOCIAL_CIRCLE, DAYS_LAST_PHONE_CHANGE, FLAG_DOCUMENT_2, FLAG_DOCUMENT_3, FLAG_DOCUMENT_4, FLAG_DOCUMENT_5, FLAG_DOCUMENT_6, FLAG_DOCUMENT_7, FLAG_DOCUMENT_8, FLAG_DOCUMENT_9, FLAG_DOCUMENT_10, FLAG_DOCUMENT_11, FLAG_DOCUMENT_12,FLAG_DOCUMENT_13, FLAG_DOCUMENT_14, FLAG_DOCUMENT_15, FLAG_DOCUMENT_16, FLAG_DOCUMENT_17, FLAG_DOCUMENT_18, FLAG_DOCUMENT_19, FLAG_DOCUMENT_20, FLAG_DOCUMENT_21))|>
  select(-c(REGION_RATING_CLIENT, REGION_RATING_CLIENT_W_CITY))




app_train <- clean_application_train|>
  select_if(is.numeric)|>
  select(-TARGET)


cor_mat <- cor(app_train)
cor_mat[!lower.tri(cor_mat)]
data.frame(cor_mat) |>
              rownames_to_column() |>
              gather(key="variable", value="correlation", -rowname) |>
              filter(abs(correlation) > 0.5)|>
              filter(abs(correlation) != 1.0)


```

```{r}




prev_en <- prevapp |>
  mutate(
    app_to_credit = AMT_APPLICATION / AMT_CREDIT,
    ann_to_credit = AMT_ANNUITY     / AMT_CREDIT,
    valid = NAME_CONTRACT_STATUS == "Approved" &
            AMT_CREDIT  > 0 &
            AMT_ANNUITY > 0 &
            CNT_PAYMENT > 0,
    INTEREST       = ifelse(valid, CNT_PAYMENT * AMT_ANNUITY - AMT_CREDIT, NA_real_),
    INTEREST_RATE  = ifelse(valid, 24 * INTEREST/(AMT_CREDIT * (CNT_PAYMENT + 1)), NA_real_),
    INTEREST_SHARE = ifelse(AMT_CREDIT > 0, INTEREST / AMT_CREDIT, NA_real_)
  )

prev_all <- prev_en |>
  group_by(SK_ID_CURR) |>
  summarise(
    prev_app_count           = n(),
    prev_amt_credit_mean     = mean(AMT_CREDIT, na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_cnt_payment_mean    = mean(CNT_PAYMENT, na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_app_to_credit_mean  = mean(app_to_credit, na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_ann_to_credit_mean  = mean(ann_to_credit, na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_approved_rate       = mean(NAME_CONTRACT_STATUS == "Approved", na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_refused_rate        = mean(NAME_CONTRACT_STATUS == "Refused",  na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_interest_sum        = sum(INTEREST, na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_interest_mean       = mean(INTEREST, na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_rate_mean_all       = mean(INTEREST_RATE, na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_rate_med_all        = median(INTEREST_RATE, na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_share_mean_all      = mean(INTEREST_SHARE, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


prev_last1 <- prev_en |>
  arrange(SK_ID_CURR, dplyr::desc(.data[["DAYS_DECISION"]])) |>
  group_by(SK_ID_CURR) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  summarise(
    prev_last1_amt_credit     = first(AMT_CREDIT),
    prev_last1_cnt_payment    = first(CNT_PAYMENT),
    prev_last1_app_to_credit  = first(app_to_credit),
    prev_last1_ann_to_credit  = first(ann_to_credit),
    prev_last1_status         = first(NAME_CONTRACT_STATUS),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

prev_last3 <- prev_en |>
  arrange(SK_ID_CURR, dplyr::desc(.data[["DAYS_DECISION"]])) |>
  group_by(SK_ID_CURR) |>
  slice_head(n = 3) |>
  summarise(
    prev_last3_n                  = n(),
    prev_last3_amt_credit_mean    = mean(AMT_CREDIT,    na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_last3_cnt_payment_mean   = mean(CNT_PAYMENT,   na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_last3_app_to_credit_mean = mean(app_to_credit, na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_last3_ann_to_credit_mean = mean(ann_to_credit, na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_last3_approved_rate      = mean(NAME_CONTRACT_STATUS == "Approved", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


prev_last5 <- prev_en |>
  arrange(SK_ID_CURR, dplyr::desc(.data[["DAYS_DECISION"]])) |>
  group_by(SK_ID_CURR) |>
  slice_head(n = 5) |>
  summarise(
    prev_last5_n                  = n(),
    prev_last5_amt_credit_mean    = mean(AMT_CREDIT,    na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_last5_cnt_payment_mean   = mean(CNT_PAYMENT,   na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_last5_app_to_credit_mean = mean(app_to_credit, na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_last5_ann_to_credit_mean = mean(ann_to_credit, na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_last5_approved_rate      = mean(NAME_CONTRACT_STATUS == "Approved", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

prev_first2 <- prev_en |>
  arrange(SK_ID_CURR, .data[["DAYS_DECISION"]]) |>
  group_by(SK_ID_CURR) |>
  slice_head(n = 2) |>
  summarise(
    prev_first2_n                  = n(),
    prev_first2_amt_credit_mean    = mean(AMT_CREDIT,    na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_first2_cnt_payment_mean   = mean(CNT_PAYMENT,   na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_first2_app_to_credit_mean = mean(app_to_credit, na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_first2_ann_to_credit_mean = mean(ann_to_credit, na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_first2_approved_rate      = mean(NAME_CONTRACT_STATUS == "Approved", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


prev_first4 <- prev_en |>
  arrange(SK_ID_CURR, .data[["DAYS_DECISION"]]) |>
  group_by(SK_ID_CURR) |>
  slice_head(n = 4) |>
  summarise(
    prev_first4_n                  = n(),
    prev_first4_amt_credit_mean    = mean(AMT_CREDIT,    na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_first4_cnt_payment_mean   = mean(CNT_PAYMENT,   na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_first4_app_to_credit_mean = mean(app_to_credit, na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_first4_ann_to_credit_mean = mean(ann_to_credit, na.rm = TRUE),
    prev_first4_approved_rate      = mean(NAME_CONTRACT_STATUS == "Approved", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


prev_features <- Reduce(function(x, y) left_join(x, y, by = "SK_ID_CURR"),
                        list(prev_all, prev_last1, prev_last3, prev_last5, prev_first2, prev_first4))

application_train_FE <- clean_application_train |> left_join(prev_features, by = "SK_ID_CURR")



```
